title: Normalized reconstruction from two successive support conditions
statement:
Let $X,Z,S,B$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ and $e:B\hookrightarrow Z$ closed immersions [def-weil-closed-immersion], and $k:X\setminus i(Z)\hookrightarrow X$, $u:S\hookrightarrow Z$ their complementary open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion], so $u(S)=Z\setminus e(B)$. Assume $k,u$ are quasi-compact morphisms: their inverse images of affine opens are quasi-compact. Let $R$ be any sheaf of commutative rings on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. All module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] below have coefficient rings obtained by inverse image of $R$ [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Use the specified module adjunction $i^{-1}\dashv i_*$ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-module-adjunction], with unit $\eta_i$ and counit $\varepsilon_i$, and $u_!\dashv u^{-1}$, with unit $\eta_u$ and counit $\varepsilon_u$, where $u_!$ is the sheafified extension-by-zero functor [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-ringed-open-closed]. Let $A$ be an $R$-module sheaf on $X$, $M$ a module sheaf on $S$, and $\sigma:u^{-1}i^{-1}A\xrightarrow{\sim}M$ an isomorphism. Suppose $k^{-1}A=0$ and $e^{-1}i^{-1}A=0$. Then
$$\lambda=\varepsilon_{u,i^{-1}A}\circ u_!(\sigma^{-1}):u_!M\longrightarrow i^{-1}A$$
is an isomorphism, and the adjoint transpose
$$\theta=i_*(\lambda^{-1})\circ\eta_{i,A}:A\longrightarrow i_*u_!M$$
is an isomorphism. It is the unique morphism with prescribed restriction
$$u^{-1}(\varepsilon_{i,u_!M})\circ u^{-1}i^{-1}(\theta)=\eta_{u,M}\circ\sigma.$$
The maps are natural for pairs of morphisms $A\to A'$, $M\to M'$ commuting with the given $\sigma,\sigma'$.

source.place: Composite consequence of Tag 09AH, lemma-ses-associated-to-open, applied to two successive complementary pairs. The specified adjunction transpose and its normalization are the support-reconstruction argument extracted from the parent, not a verbatim theorem in that tag.
